Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime

Record Class MavenRuntimeContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime.MavenRuntimeContext
Record Components:
schemaVersion - Runtime export format version.
plan - Effective variant prepared by Maven.
snapshotMetadataPath - Immutable snapshot metadata owned by this module.
producer - Maven JVM's PID and start instant; this is checked against actual ancestry at launch.
exportNonce - Current invocation/export identity, never a persistent Maven-mode flag.
public record MavenRuntimeContext(int schemaVersion, EffectiveTestPlan plan, String snapshotMetadataPath, ProcessIdentity producer, String exportNonce) extends Record
One atomic module/variant export tied to its real Maven producer process and immutable snapshot. A live ancestor identity allows Failsafe to consume the current build without another producer invocation. A direct bootstrap consumes only its own matching export nonce after its child build succeeds.
